refit: monthly, before the first session 09:45 NY decision; past completed labels only
feature_timing: Prior actual session close. No same-day high, low, close or volume. No option IV input to ML.
target: Mean future squared close-to-close log returns within each block, using only blocks fully observed before each fitting cutoff
trade_comparison: Same 480 original candidates; 60-minute hedges, +3 volatility point buffer and unchanged cost gate; strict and zero-bid scenarios separately
research_status: Exploratory historical comparison; original 2022-2025 market outcomes have already been examined, so this is not a new untouched holdout
intraday_limitation: Training labels are daily squared-return variance proxies, not continuous high-frequency realized variance; HAR model is a proxy version, not original HAR-RV
model_selection: All listed models are reported; no winner is selected by trading P&L
